MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 41% of delays on line(s) A, C (1.4x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Dwell-time programme at Jay St-MetroTech and the stops before it during 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00, 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00: platform controllers, door-closing announcements, step-back crews
recommendations.rationale: Run-time loss is spread across every stop on the approach, the signature of long dwells.
recommendations.expected_effect: Each stop recovers its excess dwell; the effect compounds along the line.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C during 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00, 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts, where C trains run ahead of A trains bound for Jay St-MetroTech
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C; use alternates F, FX
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C; add supplement trains or move work windows off 02:00-03:00, 03:00-04:00, 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Check whether scheduled dwell and run times on the approach still match observed loads; re-time the schedule if not
recommendations.rationale: A schedule with unrealistic dwells makes every train late by design.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so C and A slots are offset by at least half a headway at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.
